data.name: Anaesthetic
data.description: You know how to supplement uses of the Heal skill with pain-killing drugs. You gain Skill Focus (Heal) as a bonus feat. Any use of the Heal skill that has a risk of harming the patient (such as extracting a barb) only deals the minimum damage when performed by you.
